scripts.build:client: yarn run clean:build && cross-env DEBUG=true VERBOSE=true yarn workspace app run build:client
scripts.build:server: cross-env DEBUG=true VERBOSE=true yarn workspace app run build:server
scripts.clean:build: cross-env DEBUG=true VERBOSE=true rm -rf App/build App/.Caches
scripts.clean:yarn: rm -rf node_modules && yarn cache clean && rm yarn.lock
scripts.deploy: yarn run build:client && yarn run ftp
scripts.development: yarn run clean:build && cross-env DEBUG=true VERBOSE=true yarn workspace app run development
scripts.preview: cross-env DEBUG=true VERBOSE=true yarn workspace app run preview
scripts.production: yarn run clean:build && cross-env DEBUG=true VERBOSE=true yarn workspace app run production
